formats.description: Inline Vega-Lite specification; interpreted in a worker.
Inline Vega specification for lower-level marks, layouts and data transforms.
Passive SVG geometry, text, groups, gradients, masks and clipping. No scripts, HTML, stylesheets, images or external references.
